start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:test-prices-and-change-a-page-for-each-visitor on https://example.com/pricing: the plan card has three versions, 9, 12 and 15 a month; the page is shared in my newsletter and on a social ad account; count sign-ups and payments."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Have the page address ready, each part of it that changes with its versions (for example the plan card: 9, 12, 15), the places you share it (a newsletter, an ad account) and what counts as a result (signed up, paid). No list is needed: the versions and the rule are kept as records the workflow writes.
2. Say "Run workflow:test-prices-and-change-a-page-for-each-visitor" with page, parts (each with its versions), and optionally channels, known_facts and outcomes.

3. Read every version's words and every rule it shows you in plain words and approve only the ones you want; nothing changes for visitors before your yes, and a new price goes live only once your payment provider holds it.
4. Use the tracked link it makes for each place you share the page; a visit through a link carries its source, so each visitor sees one version and keeps seeing it.
5. Each week read the counts per version and per source; a version with fewer than 100 views is reported as too early, not as a winner. Say yes to settle, add a version, remove one or keep going.
